charge_port.notes: GM: Escalade IQ and IQL get a native NACS port for model year 2027 (autoevolution; InsideEVs 810603 and TTAC agree). US.

supercharger_access.notes: Native NACS: Superchargers need no adapter; CCS stalls need a NACS-to-CCS adapter. US.

consumption_highway_wh_per_km.notes: Estimated (B103): the 2025 Escalade IQ's measured 70 mph highway figure (InsideEVs). Long-wheelbase IQ, same pack and motors, heavier, so likely a little higher. No IQL test or rating found.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: InsideEVs and TTAC state 19.2 kW standard on every 2027 Escalade IQ trim and name the IQL only for the NACS port, not for the charger; neither confirms the IQL charger. The IQL is assumed to share the IQ onboard charger. Pack match is disputed (Cars.com says the IQL pack is 5 kWh larger, Wards says shared), so low confidence.
